title: Our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ: A Living Role Model in Our Children's Hearts
summary:
Imagine your child coming home from school, telling you about a difficult situation they faced with a friend, and how they felt angry or sad. In that moment, you wonder how to instill in them stable values that will help them deal with their emotions and life's challenges. Often, we find ourselves teaching our children about great figures, but the biggest challenge is making these figures living role models that the child sees before them, not just names mentioned in books or stories.

Belief in the Prophets is an integral part of our creed, and our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is the last of them and the dearest to our hearts. He is not only a great Prophet, but he is the excellent role model in whom the highest character traits were embodied. He was truthful and trustworthy, so much so that his people called him "the Truthful, the Trustworthy." He was merciful to young and old, gentle with the weak and with animals. When we connect these qualities to simple life situations that a child understands, we make them see the Prophet ﷺ as a wise friend they can emulate every day, in their interactions with their siblings and friends, and in facing their small challenges.

Let's start by making the Prophet's biography a part of our daily conversations. Tell your child short stories from his noble life, focusing on one character trait at a time. Teach them to say "peace and blessings of Allah be upon him" whenever his name is mentioned, not just as a habit, but as a sign of love and appreciation. Most importantly, your child should see these prophetic character traits in you first. When they see truthfulness, mercy, and gentleness embodied in their parents, it becomes easier for them to love the Prophet ﷺ and emulate him, making his character traits a part of their sound personality.
try_this: Tonight: Before bedtime, tell your child a short story from the Prophet's biography that highlights a character trait like mercy or truthfulness, then ask them: "How can we be like our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in this character trait tomorrow?"
